dedupeText: urban americana album cover sepia tone industrial background denim jacket guitar case condensed sans serif urban bridge desaturated portrait subject positioned off center left against a blurred industrial background warm sepia toned monochrome image contrasting with vibrant red typography verticality of the bridge structures echoing the condensed letterforms eye line of the subject directed away from the camera toward the right combine a desaturated warm toned industrial portrait with high contrast condensed red typography and wide tracked black sub headers for a modern americana aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, sepia-tinted portrait of a male musician standing in an industrial urban setting, featuring a high-contrast red display typeface paired with a wide-tracked sub-header.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center left against a blurred industrial background
Warm sepia-toned monochrome image contrasting with vibrant red typography
Verticality of the bridge structures echoing the condensed letterforms
Eye-line of the subject directed away from the camera toward the right
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette with a specific sepia/brown tint

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male figure occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, slightly angled.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the vibrant red text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the right, landing on the primary text block, then down to the sub-header.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blurred space on the right side under the bridge arch to accommodate typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated sepia/umber tones for the photographic background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the shadows of the jacket and bridge structure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant crimson red for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the background highlights; the red text is the only high-saturation element.
paletteRestrictions: No bright whites; highlights should be creamy or sepia-toned

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-condensed sans-serif and wide geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses extremely tall, narrow proportions with flat terminals
Secondary text uses wide, open proportions with high tracking
Uniform stroke weight in both styles

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the blurred background area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-narrow display text paired with ultra-wide sub-header.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment of text block with the subject's midsection

preserve: Condensed verticality of the main name
Wide letter spacing of the title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, narrow, bold sans-serif display style
Captures the wide, geometric feel for the sub-header

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned, desaturated photograph of a man with medium-length dark hair wearing a denim jacket, standing under a steel urban bridge. He is looking to the side. The right side of the image should be a blurred street scene under an archway. The overall mood is gritty but clean.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a bold, extra-condensed red sans-serif font on the right side. Below it, add the album title in a wide-tracked, black geometric sans-serif font, all caps.

verificationChecks: Is the red text the only saturated color?
Is the sub-header significantly wider in tracking than the main name?
Is the background sepia-toned rather than pure grayscale?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for the text
Subject's clothing style (e.g., leather vs denim)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any brand logos on the jacket or guitar case
postGenerationChecks: Text is legible against the blurred background
The red color pops without bleeding into the sepia tones
The subject's gaze leads the viewer toward the text
The industrial texture of the bridge is visible but not distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated, warm-toned industrial portrait with high-contrast, condensed red typography and wide-tracked black sub-headers for a modern Americana aesthetic.
